title: The Grimoires
answer: Grimoires cast twelve practical authored rituals and never inherit player-rank scaling. Celestial holds Soul Compass, Augury, Cartographer's Star and Celestial Ruin; Deep holds only Dimensional Anchor; Blight holds Blood Reading and Grave Recall; Wild holds Purification Circle, Verdant Tending and Hearth Sanctuary; Abyssal holds Ward-Breaking Ritual (Amethyst Unmaking) and Dispel (Unweaving). The Infernal volume is a hidden dormant compatibility alias. Every spell uses the existing magic-energy pool and bespoke effects instead of potion particles.
